pages.en:
I break into a run.

Zouken's laughter echoing through the room no longer matters.

He is not even here. He is looking down on us from somewhere safe.

Right now, the taunts of that miserable old man matter far less than—
pages.mirrorMoon:
I run.
I don’t care about the laughter.
I’m sure he’s watching me from a safe place.
There’s no time to let an old man’s drivel get to me

pages.en:
I drive my feet against the earth as though willing my legs to tear themselves apart.

“Illya, please be safe—!”

The house is twenty minutes away at a dead run.

Glaring up at the gray sky, I race toward Illya with no thought for anything else.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I kick the ground hard enough to tear my legs off.
“Please be all right, Illya!”
It’ll take twenty minutes to get to my house, even if I run full-speed.
I glare at the gray sky and run frantically back to Illya.
